business_summary: GuangDong SongYang Recycle Resources CO.,LTD engages in the research and development, production, and sale of corrugated paper and specialty paper in China and internationally. It offers whiteboard paper, corrugated paper, and other products, such as thermal paper and self-adhesive paper. The company was formerly known as Shantou Songyang Paper Industry Co., Ltd. GuangDong SongYang Recycle Resources CO.,LTD was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Shantou, China.
business_summary_ko: GuangDong SongYang Recycle Resources CO.,LTD는 중국 및 국제적으로 골판지 및 특수 용지의 연구 개발, 생산 및 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. 화이트보드지, 골판지, 감열지, 접착지 등 기타 제품을 제공합니다. 회사의 이전 명칭은 Shantou Songyang Paper Industry Co., Ltd. GuangDong SongYang Recycle Resources CO.,LTD는 2008년에 설립되었으며 중국 산터우에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
